def compute(v):
    enabled = v['enabled']
    a = v['a']
    b = v['b']
    expected = v['expected']
    check(enabled, 'Disabled', 0)
    sum_ab = add(a, b, 1)
    check(sum_ab == expected, 'Mismatch', 2)
    incremented = add(sum_ab, 1, 3)
    premium_result = add(incremented, 2, 4)
    check(premium_result <= 1000, 'PremiumLimit', 5)
    return premium_result
